recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Only revisit if a new FHIR-I decision asks to add specific UCUM annotation examples or otherwise changes quantity canonicalization search policy.
issue_request: FHIR-13874 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I clarification request for the FHIR-core search quantity page. It asked to make the canonical-units search text clearer for UCUM behavior such as annotations and unit conversion; the approved resolution was to add a UCUM reference with a note.

additional_context: The current source/search.html page is active in the build via publish.ini. Later search-page history corrected the example from 0.23 m/hr to 0.023 m/hr, fixed spelling, and added adjacent range-search guidance without contradicting the FHIR-13874 UCUM note. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current text says search processors may use canonical units, gives a concrete mm/hr-to-m/sec example, links conversions to UCUM semantics, and states the limitation for servers that do not canonicalize.
